title: Commercial Use and Road Hazard Protection Claims
content:
Holding a Crestline Fleet Account changes what Road Hazard Protection pays on the fleet's vehicles.

**Rule.** A vehicle is in commercial use on a claim date when its usage class is commercial, or when it was on a Crestline fleet account roster (an enrollment entry not ended by a later removal entry) at any time between the certificate's effective date and the claim date. When the vehicle is in commercial use on the claim date, only a plan that covers commercial use — the Commercial LT plan — pays the claim; every consumer plan pays nothing on a vehicle in commercial use, and the claim is serviced at the store's regular price. When the vehicle is not in commercial use, every plan pays under its own terms.

**Authority.** The holder's statement that a vehicle is used privately does not override a fleet roster record or a commercial usage class.

| Vehicle on the claim date | Commercial LT certificate | Consumer plan certificate |
|---|---|---|
| in commercial use | pays under its terms | pays nothing; regular price |
| not in commercial use | pays under its terms | pays under its terms |

*Hypothetical case.* A pickup with personal usage class was enrolled on a fleet roster in the second month of a 36-Month certificate and removed in the fifth month. A claim in the eighth month falls in a period during which the vehicle was on the roster, so the 36-Month plan pays nothing on it.
